{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
print("Distribution of arm:", df['arm'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("Distribution of severity:", df['severity'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check if responded is binary
print("Unique values in responded:", df['responded'].unique())"}
